basic_info.description: New Price! Absolutely stunning top-floor luxury penthouse in a boutique 9-unit elevator building built in 2017 by Sternberg Benjamin Architects. This 2BD/2.5BA two-level home features floor-to-ceiling windows with expansive western views, including Sutro Tower. Enjoy internal access to a large private deeded roof deck with sweeping 360 city and downtown views. Open-concept main level with living/dining, gas fireplace, and gourmet kitchen with Miele appliances, custom European cabinetry, and Carrara marble backsplash. Spacious lower level with luxurious primary suite, heated bathroom floors, Porcelanosa tile, and custom closets. 2nd BD + bath, in-unit laundry, wide-plank hardwood, Bonelli windows, Boffi cabinetry, and more. Includes 1-car parking with EV charger, large storage closet, and secure entry. Prime North Slope Potrero Hill, just steps to 18th St shops, cafes, parks, transit, and freeways.
